title: 10 Fun Manners Activities for Preschoolers
benefit: Simple habits that stick. Low prep.

photos.alt: A small child's wooden treasure box and blank cream clue cards on a light oak coffee table in warm morning window light.
A clear glass jar half-filled with pastel wool pom-poms on a light oak breakfast table in soft morning light.
A child's place setting on a wooden table with ceramic plate, rolled sage linen napkin, and green and red circle markers.

steps.title: Kindness Pom-Pom Jar
steps.body: Drop a pastel pom-pom in the jar for every kind word.

steps.title: Table Manners Red Light
steps.body: Use colorful card discs to practice polite mealtime habits.
